name: Plurai Simulation
summary: Simulation layer that wires an AI agent into a mocked world so you can test runs, score failures and improve the agent before users hit the same issues.
description: Simulation layer that wires an AI agent into a mocked world so you can test runs, score failures and improve the agent before users hit the same issues.

pricing.details: Free 0 € with 12,300 credits one-time (2 agent setups, 7 scenarios, 3 runs, 10 sandbox hours one-time; no pay-as-you-go — upgrade to continue). Base 54 €/month — 28,710 credits/month, 3 agent setups, 14 scenarios, 20 runs/month, 20 traces/month, 30 sandbox hours/month. Business 190 €/month — 65,570 credits/month, 3 agent setups or 1 with 16 extra scenarios, 28 scenarios (or 44 with 1 setup), 60 runs/month, 40 traces/month, 100 sandbox hours/month. Official pay-as-you-go per-credit rates are recorded in the official (non-displayed) notes only, because they are too small to show as whole euros. The Free plan is one-time credits, not a lasting free allowance — labelled Premium.
pricing.label: Premium
